neet_phy_u10_t05_2.working: In a lift accelerating upward, g_eff = g + g/3 = 4g/3. T' = 2/√(4/3) = √3 = 1.73 s.

neet_phy_u10_t05_3.working: ΔT/T = ½(Δl/l) = 0.1%. The clock runs slow and loses 0.001 × 86400 = 86.4 s.

neet_phy_u10_t05_4.working: Upward lift: g+a, so IV. Downward lift: g−a, so I. Free fall: g_eff = 0, no oscillation, so II. Horizontally accelerating car: g_eff = √(g²+a²), so III.

neet_phy_u10_t05_5.working: A is true. B is false: effective length runs to the centre of the bob. C is true: standing raises the centre of mass, shortening the effective length. D is false: g is smaller on the Moon, so T is larger. E is true: the formula holds only for small amplitudes.
